title: Taking Back Authority Over the Enemy
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he ignites a call to action, urging believers to take back authority over the devil and step into their full potential in Christ. Through a powerful message of hope and breakthrough, Pastor Zehner encourages the congregation to come out of their struggles and experience the life-changing power of God. Don't miss this inspiring sermon that will leave you feeling empowered and ready to take on the challenges of life.
